note: Roosevelt NF, ~8,600 ft, in beetle-thinned lodgepole beside the Laramie River near its confluence with the West Branch, ~7 mi north of CO-14 on the gravel Laramie River Road (Larimer CR 103), NW of Cameron Pass. --Claude
summary: FS campground page (found; stored website was the ARP recreation index) + ARP campground status table: confirmed 49 sites, FCFS, $28, vault toilets, potable water; added max spur 40 ft (page range 25-70), season June 12 - Oct 11, bear lockers. Note cleaned of field facts. Pin is ~580 m off. Waterfront riverfront looks like creekside by size (flag).
flags: Website: stored https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation is the forest's recreation index. The campground's own page is https://www.fs.usda.gov/r02/arp/recreation/tunnel-campground. No recreation.gov listing (FCFS).

Phone: none stored. Canyon Lakes Ranger District Office, Fort Collins, 970-295-6600 (ARP offices page; the same number is also the Supervisor's Office and Clear Creek RD line). The campground page itself lists no contact. Suggest 970-295-6600.

Length: ARP campground status table 'Max Spur 40’'; campground page 'The parking length ranges from 25 to 70 feet.' Both agency figures are over 23 ft (even the shortest spur is 25 ft), so no criteria problem. Recorded 40, the status table's maximum; the 70 on the campground page conflicts.

Road: ARP conditions road table (updated 10/14/2026) 'Laramie River (County Road 103) CR 103 OPEN - Visit Larimer County Road and Bridge for county road closures'. Neither page has RV, trailer or 4WD wording for CR 103. The campground page shows a 'Site Closed' banner (the status table's 2026 season ended Oct 11; ordinary season end).

Pin: stored 40.6680,-105.8584 is ~580 m SSW of the FS point (40.67278,-105.855686), on CR 103 beside a small separate pull-off loop with a structure, south of the campground. On imagery the campground's loops lie around the FS point, west of CR 103. Suggest moving the pin to the FS point. No recreation.gov catalog.

Waterfront: stored riverfront. On imagery the Laramie River here is a narrow meandering stream, roughly 4-8 m wide, threading between the campground's loops, with some spurs ending within ~20-30 m of it under thinned lodgepole. By the size rule (under ~30 m wide) that is creekside, not riverfront. Suggest riverfront -> creekside; no per-site coordinates, so which site numbers sit on the bank could not be named.
